notes: «قالوا سمعنا» — three co-transmitters of one level, all hearing Abu Umama
«سمعنا أبا أمامة الباهلي» and «يقول سمعت عمرو بن عبسة» are rule 5 links; Amr is the Companion whose words relay the saying
«قلت يا رسول الله ...» is Amr's own question inside his report; the Prophet is the end, not a link
